descriptions.r8: When a vehicle is 5–10 m ahead in the lane and the car is closing in on it (more than 5 m/s faster), slow down; but if no other vehicle is seen, change lanes instead: to either side from the middle lane, to the right from the leftmost lane, to the left from the rightmost lane.
descriptions.r8b: When a vehicle is 5–10 m ahead in the lane and the car is closing in on it (more than 5 m/s faster), never accelerate.
descriptions.r29: When a vehicle is right next to the car in the lane to its right, do not change lanes to the right.

items.caption: An ordinary moment on the road, drawn the way a diagnosis draws a situation: the ego in dark blue in the middle lane, and the four cars it sees in yellow, the colour a diagnosis gives the cars its rule names.

descriptions.r8: When an obstacle (a car, a person, a rider or another obstacle) appears ahead, stop.
descriptions.r13: When the traffic light ahead is red or yellow, stop.
descriptions.r13b: When there is a stop sign ahead, stop.
descriptions.r15: When the traffic light ahead is green, drive on; if there is an obstacle ahead, or possibly a pedestrian (30% confidence or more), stop.
descriptions.r3: When a pedestrian may be ahead but it is uncertain (30–85% confidence), stop (cautious braking).
descriptions.r28: When the left is blocked (no lane, an obstacle in the left lane, or a solid line), do not turn or change lanes to the left.
descriptions.r29: When the right is blocked (no lane, an obstacle in the right lane, or a solid line), do not turn or change lanes to the right.
